evals.prompt: Start a coding session and keep my Mac awake for 45 minutes.
evals.expected_output: Convert 45 minutes to 2700 seconds; check `$TMPDIR/caffeine-time.pid` for an existing timer; start detached `/usr/bin/caffeinate -i -t 2700` (no `-d` unless asked), write its PID to the pidfile, and verify it is running. Report the approximate local end time, the PID, and `kill <pid>` to stop. Mention that closing the lid or manually sleeping/shutting down can still interrupt it. Do not use `pmset` or claim success if the command could not be run.

Read the PID from `$TMPDIR/caffeine-time.pid`, confirm it is caffeinate, `kill` only that PID, verify it exited, and remove the pidfile. If none is running, say so. Never use `killall` or `pkill`.
